title: VisionProductRequest
description: vision.product-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/product. The image is embedded locally with CLIP; `allow_rerank` lets one routed model reorder the candidate offers. Candidates come from OpenVibe.Deals and open.shoes; Vision never invents a price.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.
